Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Finalize order form pricing & VAT handling

Hi Liz —

Thanks for taking time on Friday. Per our map (attached) I wanted to get a concise list of the remaining commercial bullets so legal & procurement can close the order form this week. Attached: ACME_OrderForm_v3.pdf (current draft).

Quick summary / asks from our side:
- Pricing & tiers: confirm whether you want the 250k or 500k slab for year 1 (pricing table on p.2).
- Minimum commit: propose 3-month ramp (25% / 50% / 25%) before full annual commit begins.
- Net terms: we can do Net 30 on recurring invoices; procurement asked about Net 45 — can you confirm final required term?
- Invoicing entity + tax: please confirm which legal entity will accept invoices and whether Acme will provide VAT/Tax certificate or expect withholding.

If procurement needs the PO template, please attach and we will map invoice fields.

Attaching: ACME_OrderForm_v3.pdf

Would love to get a reply with the Procurement contact + preferred net terms so we can route to legal for redlines.

Best,

From: Liz Monroe <liz.monroe@acmehealth.com>

Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Finalize order form pricing & VAT handling

Mina —

Thanks for the clear summary. Procurement looped me in and attached their PO template (ACME_Procurement_PO_Template.docx). A few clarifications from our side:

- Pricing slab: Finance prefers the 250k slab to start; we can revisit after Q1 usage.
- Minimum commit: procurement will accept the 3-month ramp you proposed, but they need an explicit cancellation window (30 days) in case of regulatory holds.
- Net terms: our standard is Net 45. I know that differs from your Net 30 ask — is there flexibility on Redwood's side for a one-time onboarding invoice upfront (Net 30) and Net 45 thereafter?
- Tax: Acme operates in multiple EU jurisdictions; procurement says we cannot sign anything that forces us to absorb VAT without a reverse-charge mechanism. They'll need either a VAT certificate or an explicit reverse-charge clause.

Forwarding procurement contact for next steps: procurement@acmehealth.com (they prefer all invoicing questions in-thread).

Liz
Liz Monroe
Director, Digital Services — Acme Health
liz.monroe@acmehealth.com

Thanks Liz — appreciated. Quick reply and proposal so we have a concrete set for legal:

- Pricing slab: accept 250k for year 1.
- Minimum commit: 3-month ramp as suggested with a 30-day cancellation window during ramp only (after ramp completes the annual commit is fixed).
- Net terms: Redwood can accept Net 45 on recurring invoices if Acme signs that onboarding/activation invoice (one-off) at Net 30; we will reflect this split in the order form.
- Tax: propose we add a reverse-charge clause for EU entities + request Acme provide a VAT certificate where applicable. If reverse-charge is not accepted for specific entities, we will add a tax-indemnity line allocating withholding responsibility to the paying party.

Ben — can you confirm finance is OK with the Net 30 activation / Net 45 recurring split?

If procurement sends the PO fields we will map them to our billing system and share an invoice sample. Once procurement confirms, I will ask Legal to produce the tracked redline (cc'ing Kimberly).

Thanks —
Mina

3) Clarify credit / refund mechanics on prorated ramp period and cancellation within ramp.

Subject: Re: MAP: Finalize order form pricing & VAT handling — legal next steps

Ben / Mina / Procurement —

Thanks for the context and the initial redline. Legal has reviewed Ben's starter and will deliver a tracked MSA + Order Form redline by tomorrow EOD. High-level notes upfront:

- Invoicing entity: we will add a required 'Billing Entity' table in the order form and a clause that the customer must provide a Tax/VAT certificate within 15 days of countersignature.
- Net terms: we will document the split (Onboarding invoice: Net 30; Recurring: Net 45) and add a clause with a 1.5% monthly late fee after grace period for non-payment — this is standard.
- Tax & withholding: include reverse-charge language for EU entities; fallback is that Acme remains responsible for any withholding unless Acme provides evidence (VAT certificate) to support reverse-charge. This preserves Redwood's ability to recover withholding in rare jurisdictions.
- Cancellation during ramp: include explicit pro-rata credit mechanics and requirement to give 30 days' notice during ramp; once ramp completes, the annual minimum is binding.

Procurement — please upload the completed PO template and VAT certificate(s) to the Google doc (link below) so Finance can validate the billing fields. Once we receive the docs we will prepare the DocuSign envelope and a final estimate for any tax gross-up that might be required.

Related links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1example-map (MAP + attachments), HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890
DocuSign preview will be shared after paperwork is complete: https://www.docusign.com/some/link

If everyone is aligned on the above, I will send the tracked redline and a short summary for countersignature routing.

—Kimberly Park
